name: Maimonides
contribution: A Sephardic Jewish rabbi who is widely acknowledged as one of the most prolific and influential Torah scholars of the Middle Ages.
legacy: To date, this person is recognized as one of the foremost rabbinic decisors and his copious work comprises a cornerstone of Jewish scholarship.

checks.lead: Moses ben Maimon (died 12 December 1204), commonly known as Maimonides and also referred to by the Hebrew acronym Rambam, was a Sephardic Jewish rabbi who is widely acknowledged as one of the most prolific and influential Torah scholars of the Middle Ages.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
